reason: No regulator has written a rule or brought an enforcement case that says I need a separate gate in front of agent MCP calls. Until one does, caps, a kill switch and a decision log are things my team can build ourselves on the API keys we already issue. The price is fine, but I'm not putting a line in next year's budget for a vendor with no customers and no SOC 2 to fix a problem the rules don't make me fix yet.
objection: We can build this ourselves, and 'mapped to FINRA's expectations' means guidance and speeches, not a rule I'll be examined on. Also, putting a pre-SOC 2 startup's proxy in front of order flow is a vendor-risk headache my compliance team won't sign off on lightly.
would_change_my_mind: A written FINRA rule, an exam finding or an enforcement action that specifically requires pre-trade controls and audit evidence for customer AI agents, plus a finished SOC 2 report from the vendor.
